description: This Java source file defines an abstract class JdbcValueHandler<T> which provides mechanisms for getting and setting JDBC column values, including handling different Java and SQL types. It includes internal subclasses for handling specific data types like String, Integer, Date, Blob, Clob, etc. The class also manages mappings to select appropriate handlers based on Java types and SQL types.

classes.name: JdbcValueHandler
classes.description: Abstract base class for handling getting and setting various Java types to JDBC PreparedStatement and ResultSet objects, with internal subclasses for specific types.

classes.name: JdbcValueHandler.ClobJdbcValueHandler
classes.description: Handles Clob data types in JDBC, with string conversion for backwards compatibility.

classes.name: JdbcValueHandler.ObjectJdbcValueHandler
classes.description: Handles generic Object type, serializing/deserializing data.

classes.name: JdbcValueHandler.TimestampJdbcValueHandler
classes.description: Handles java.sql.Timestamp objects, including special handling for CHAR types.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an appropriate JdbcValueHandler based on Java type and SQL type, using internal maps.

methods.name: parseSqlType
methods.description: Converts SQL type string to uppercase, removing any size specifications.

methods.name: serializeObject
methods.description: Serializes a Java object into a byte array for storage in BLOBs.
